name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At the Stonewrought Dam, sabotage threatens the barrier that holds back Loch Modan's waters. You find a barrel near the shore and bring its strange smelling powder to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

sections.title: A Suspicious Discovery
sections.body: Whispers of sabotage have reached the shore around the Stonewrought Dam. Near the water's edge, a barrel lies where it does not belong. Inside is strange, pungent powder, far from the dam's maintenance supplies.

sections.title: Alarm at the Dam
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is alarmed when you bring him a sample. His reaction confirms Loch Modan's worst fears: an outside force is plotting against the dam. Now the inquiry is urgent, for the region's defense.

faq.q: What is the strange smelling powder?
faq.answer: The strange smelling powder in the barrel is an explosive or alchemical agent planted near the Stonewrought Dam's base. It is evidence that an enemy plots to destroy or compromise the barrier.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven master engineer responsible for the Stonewrought Dam's maintenance, integrity, and safety in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where is the suspicious barrel found?
faq.answer: The suspicious barrel is hidden along the shoreline near the Stonewrought Dam's foundation in northern Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is the Stonewrought Dam being targeted?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam holds back Loch Modan's vast reservoir. If it breaks, catastrophic flooding would tear through the Wetlands below, crippling Alliance trade routes and devastating dwarven holdings across Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Who left the suspicious barrel here?
faq.answer: Agents seeking to destabilize dwarven lands placed the barrel. Chief Engineer Hinderweir has begun a broader investigation into who is behind the plot.

faq.q: What should I do after collecting the powder?
faq.answer: Take the sample to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII atop the Stonewrought Dam so he can inspect it and prepare a response.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Stonewrought Dam as one of the Ironforge dwarves' greatest architectural feats. Any threat to it endangers the safety and pride of Khaz Modan.
As a gnome, you appreciate the precision of dwarven civil works. That makes the chemical nature of this crude sabotage especially concerning.
As an engineer, you recognize the danger of volatile powders deliberately planted at the stress points of a major dam.
